verdict.rationale: Both the official site and the GitHub README state that `pip install packagename` works on-device in a-Shell for pure-Python packages, which matches the story's scope exactly. Python itself ships with the app. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of pip installs working, and deeper documentation of pip behavior (install location, dependency handling, upgrade/uninstall).

support.subject: As a developer, I can install additional pure-Python packages using pip directly on my device

citations.quote: For Python, you can install more packages with `pip install packagename`, but only if they are pure Python.
Use 'pip install' to add more Python packages (if they are pure Python).
a-Shell has several programming languages installed: Python, Lua, JS, C, C++ and TeX.
